VI.description: Saves ONE VI or .ctl for an older LabVIEW with LabVIEW's own Save for Previous Version: Open VI Reference, {LV.VI} Save.For Previous, Close Reference. The same path as save path saves it in place. Only this file is written, none of its dependencies. Measured 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-23 (docs/save-version.md section 6): a 26.0 VI and a 26.0 typedef saved for the string 20.0 read 20.0. The ActiveX method SaveForPrevious with the same string wrote 25.0 instead (2026-11-23), which is why lvai_save_for_previous runs this helper.

Control.description: Where to save. The same path as vi path saves in place.
Oldest compatible target version as LabVIEW writes it, e.g. 20.0.
